race.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
race.verdict: Although ODEGAARD finished behind Miss You Nights at Wolverhampton, he caught the eye with the way he ran on and may be able to turn the tables on Jack Channon's charge on 4 lb better terms. Texting should benefit from the drop back to 7f and is next on the list ahead of Printing Money , another from the Miss You Nights Wolverhampton race. ODEGAARD MISS YOU NIGHTS TEXTING
